name: texpack
note: The HD texture pack (src/common/texpack.cpp): its pictures indexed at the start (.dds packs too), and in the first courtyard three in four or more of the textures the pack can have (the P8 ones; the rest are the pack's known gaps, such as the save frame) drawn with its picture (CV_TEXPACK_CENSUS lists what each texture got). With --set texture_pack=false none is; --set texture_pack_size=1024 loads the pictures at that size at most.

expect: (total(runlog, r'texpack: (\d+) pictures') >= 1000) if settings.texture_pack else not found(runlog, r'texpack: \d+ pictures')
(len(found(runlog, r'census: P8 .*: picture')) >= 0.75 * len(found(runlog, r'census: P8 .*: (picture|none)'))) if settings.texture_pack else not found(runlog, r'census: .*: picture')
not settings.texture_pack or found(runlog, 'up to %d px' % (2048 if settings.texture_pack_size is None else settings.texture_pack_size))
